patch_description:
This version switches to a regime-invariant, micro-regime feature bank rather than long-horizon technical indicators.  
The core idea is to convert price, volatility, volume, and funding into short-window standardized signals, then add rate-of-change and interaction terms so the trees can learn when a pattern is strengthening or weakening across regimes.

Why this should work better:
- It avoids relying on absolute levels that tend to break under regime shifts.
- It emphasizes short lookbacks (5–20 bars) and rolling z-scores/ranks, which are more stable across changing volatility.
- It adds trend-of-regime features like volatility momentum, efficiency momentum, and spread between fast/slow normalized signals.
- It keeps the model compact but expressive, with enough trees to learn nonlinear interactions without over-regularizing into mean predictions.
